status: frozen before fresh retrieval; hashed on disk, not git-committed because the user forbids commits
authorship: Codex source-authored and author-checked; independent label review pending
primary_comparison: callee minus plain on new30; both is secondary and cannot replace a rejected primary

retrieval.status: frozen before expanded retrieval scoring; no tuning
retrieval.primary_comparison: rerank50 minus rerank20 on all90; also compare each against hybrid
retrieval.code_rerank_instruction: Given a developer question, retrieve the code that implements the requested behaviour
retrieval.embedding_query_instruction:
Instruct: Given a developer question or a description of behaviour, retrieve the code that implements it
Query:
retrieval.proof_rule: Any one labelled sufficient evidence set; at least 90 percent of every required range in that set. Do not combine partial pieces of different alternatives into a complete proof.
retrieval.timing: Independent actual production calls, rotated ordering, warm synchronized p50/p95 separately per repo. Do not average percentiles. Repetitions are not independent questions.
retrieval.hardware: A100 for experiments only; deployment hardware undecided
retrieval.authorship: Source-authored and reviewed by the same assistant; independent review pending
retrieval.prior_exposure: Retained15 plus newly authored75; overlap with previously assessed v2 evidence is recorded per question. New wording is not independent code or training-data freshness.
retrieval.decision: No automatic policy/default selection. A CI spanning zero is inconclusive, not equivalence. Inspect MRR, complete proof and test/example guards with latency. Independent review and eventual deployment timing remain required.
retrieval.scope: Answerable questions over code in three pinned repositories/two languages; not a random production-query distribution, ANN scale test, abstention test or generated-answer accuracy benchmark. No character-vs-AST causal comparison.

expansion.scope: after reranked code top10 only; no hybrid/CPU expansion; same number of chunks; first five retained; insertions are unscored

success_rule.fresh_proof_lower_bound: strictly greater than zero, paired group 95% CI
success_rule.regression_guard_unit: pooled per stratum across original120, point-estimate losses in MRR@10 and any_complete_proof@10; per-repo diagnostics also reported
success_rule.text_growth_unit: ratio of total returned characters including headers to plain minus one; each of fresh30 and regression120 must meet the cap
success_rule.failure_action: leave expansion off; proceed to Phase 5 without iterating on these labels

score_sharing: one resident code-instruction scorer with exact cache by instruction/query/candidate text; all methods still call actual production search and store-backed expansion; not timing evidence
labels: single sufficient proof per new question with jointly required ranges; original120 copied byte-for-byte; independent review pending
source_only_validation: all30 proofs are corpus-answerable and none is complete in a single production chunk; no query search or expansion output consulted while authoring
preflight: any later local BM25/preflight output is diagnostic only; never substitutes for the actual GPU primary comparison
limits: name matching, not actual resolved calls
ambiguous/common names skipped above three defining chunks
no answer-generation measurement, independently authored holdout, or inference about ANN scale
prior source overlap on the old repos is recorded; new question wording is not guaranteed unseen code
